title: Early Cotton Spinners
authors: Knitting Together: East Midlands knitting industry heritage
lineage: Brief research notes; not a source copy.

passages.note: The heritage account states the Nottingham plant used horse power and that maintaining and expanding it was expensive; the partners sought another power source and set up mills in Derbyshire. Its asserted history of Paul’s machinery is not adopted as a resolution of the competing scholarship on the earlier working machines.
